split_policy.validation: official validation; model and safe-threshold selection only
split_policy.test: official test; one-shot evaluation after this config is frozen

baselines.explicit_keyword: frozen English and Traditional/Simplified Chinese memory-request regex
baselines.length_only: character count with class-weighted logistic regression
baselines.tfidf_word_char: word 1-2 gram plus character 2-5 gram TF-IDF with class-weighted logistic regression

operating_point.rule: lowest observed-score threshold whose validation false-save rate is at most 1%; ties stay together

expect_then_check.expected: surface text will be materially predictive because the silver generator uses category- and cue-specific language
expect_then_check.failure_condition: seed-held-out TF-IDF AUPRC is near the 0.5 balanced-class prior or the safe operating point has negligible SAVE recall
